summary: AXIA Energia filed a Form 6-K (report of foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16) containing its first-quarter 2026 results. This is a routine earnings release, not a special situation. The report covers operational and financial results, capital allocation, investments, and debt management. It mentions asset transactions (sale of EMAE stake, uncrossing of transmission stakes, signing of sale contract for minority stakes in transmission companies) but these are part of ongoing portfolio management, not discrete special-situation events. The filing does not announce a formal acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC business combination, or forced management change. Therefore, no special-situation category applies.
